mentions.name: Fless
mentions.description: A lean-back apartment-hunting service that takes over the manual slog of finding a place, skipping spreadsheets, endless emails, scheduling work, and spammy building follow-ups while connecting renters with vetted buildings, movers, and other moving-related services. It has launched in Chicago, New York, and Santa Clara with more cities coming online, accepts city requests from users not yet served, and offers an endpoint so AI agents can perform apartment searches on a user's behalf.
mentions.problem: Finding an apartment is a slog involving spreadsheets, endless emails, scheduling work, and spammy building follow-ups.
mentions.audience: Apartment seekers in supported cities who want a hands-off search and move experience, plus users who prefer letting an AI agent handle the search for them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
At https://fless.io we're turning the slog of finding an apartment into a lean back experience.

We help you skip the spreadsheets, endless emails, scheduling work and spammy building follow-ups while connecting you with vetted buildings, movers and other moving related services.

mentions.name: Fless
mentions.description: This AI agent helps users find apartments: they state what they want, and the service filters and sorts listings, reaches out to properties to confirm a unit meeting the criteria is actually available by the requested move-in date, schedules tours, coordinates the tour calendar (including Uber rides), and protects privacy from post-tour spam. It also helps review lease agreements, identify discounts to ask for, and schedule vetted movers. It recently launched skills and MCP integration so AI agents such as Perplexity, OpenClaw, Hermes, and Claude can use it, available via GitHub and PyPI.
mentions.problem: Apartment hunting normally means juggling emails, texts, and spreadsheets, and sharing contact details exposes renters to post-tour spam.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're working on an apartment hunting agent called Fless (https://fless.io).

Tell us what apartment you want.

We filter, sort and reach out to confirm apartments actually have a unit that meets your criteria by the move-in date you're looking for.

mentions.name: fless.io
mentions.description: This service helps users find apartments without emails, phone calls, or scheduling hassle. Users specify what they're looking for (move-in date, bedrooms, location, rent), the service reaches out to buildings that may match, and users receive a calendar of in-person or virtual tours once buildings confirm availability. Tour scheduling is optimized for efficient logistics between buildings, with additional services like verified moving companies, utilities switching, and move-in/out cleaning planned. Currently available in the DMV area with more regions coming soon.
mentions.problem: Apartment hunting typically involves many emails, phone calls, and complicated tour scheduling logistics.
mentions.audience: Renters searching for apartments, currently in the DMV area
